name: vl/json-unpacked-nested
note: Loki line {"a":{"lvl":"dbg"},"level":"info"} gives debug; VictoriaLogs sorts fields, so document order is lost and depth-0 keys are read first

name: vl/json-unpacked-deep
note: Loki line {"a":{"b":{"level":"error"}},"msg":"ok"}; keyword scan of the reconstructed line

name: vl/json-unpacked-null-dropped
note: Loki line {"method":"GET","error":null,"status":200} gives error; VictoriaLogs drops null values

name: vl/json-unpacked-stream-level
note: stream label wins over the body

name: vl/otel-number-only-info2
note: exporter sent number 10 without text; Loki maps the number

name: vl/otel-unspecified
note: exporter sent neither; Loki scans the body

name: vl/otel-real-text
note: exporter text differs from the number form

name: vl/otel-synthesized-then-later-name
note: a synthesised severity_text was never stored by Loki, so a later level field name counts

name: vl/stream-detected-level
note: a detected_level stream field is an index label for Loki; the entry value is derived and exposed as detected_level_extracted

name: vl/stream-detected-level-body
note: live Loki 3.7.1: stream label detected_level=info, detected_level_extracted=error

name: vl/stream-detected-level-nolevel
note: live Loki 3.7.1: stream label detected_level=Warning, detected_level_extracted=unknown

name: vl-pre-1.50/severity-info2
note: v1.47-v1.49 store the number-derived name as severity (captured on v1.49.0)

name: vl-pre-1.50/severity-unspecified
note: v1.47-v1.49: no severity sent, keyword scan of the line

name: vl-pre-1.50/severity-text-notice
note: v1.47-v1.49: unknown text kept raw like Loki

name: vl-pre-1.50/later-name-wins
note: Loki stored no severity_text: lvl is checked before the number

name: vl-pre-1.50/severity-with-number
note: severity_number present: not the pre-1.50 shape, severity read as stored
